searchText: I seem to have forgotten, is acd happening this week? <timbeiko> Assuming The Merge happens roughly when it's scheduled, then I think we should keep it <timbeiko> if it gets delayed and conflicts with ACD, then I would cancel, but if we have at least a few hours between them, I think it'd be good to have it so we can debrief. Definitely doesn't have to be a long call, though! Good luck finding anyone awake and/or without a hangover Ah, the true Australian experience...
